sources.grammar: Forskrift om nettregulering og energimarkedet kap. 14 as implemented by every Norwegian DSO since 2022-07-01: a monthly capacity fee (fastledd) in steps, set by the average of the three highest hours on three different days of the month. HLD §8, NO row.
sources.steps: ASSUMED: the step boundaries 2/5/10/15/20 kW and the fees 137/244/416/613/812/1200 NOK/month are Tensio's 2026-01-01 household table (D2 §6) used as the representative national one. Fees differ per DSO; the boundaries barely do. The preset file marks the version assumed.
